title: Shallower ReLU Network Representations via Exact Linear Algebra
summary: We study the depth required by ReLU networks to exactly represent piecewise linear functions, focusing specifically on the maximum function. This problem has recently received significant attention in both the ML and TCS literature. We prove that $\max_n(x)=\max\{x_1,\ldots,x_n\}$ is exactly representable with two hidden layers for every $n\leq 12$. Previously, this was only known up to $n\leq5$ [Bakaev, Brunck, Hertrich, Stade, Yehudayoff, STOC'26].
